scope: Proposition 6.2 of the manuscript “The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six” (preprints/The-Campana-Peternell-conjecture-in-dimension-six-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 067 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c6c7151f9581ddd5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every smooth complex Fano sixfold with nef tangent bundle, Picard number one and pseudoindex five is isomorphic to Gr(2, 5).
